about: The text every Agora page shares, kept as one noun: the header and its navigation, the endpoints, the deck viewer's labels and the footer. The agent banner's words are their own noun, agent-banner.json. scripts/build_site.py renders both into every page that is not frozen. Fields ending in _html hold trusted markup; every other field is plain text.

deck.help_html: Use the arrow keys or swipe to change slides; on a slide wider than the window, the arrow keys scroll it first. Once a slide or a deck button has focus, <kbd>N</kbd> shows the speaker notes and <kbd>O</kbd> the outline.

footer.privacy: No analytics, ads or cookies. Fonts load from Google Fonts, which sees your IP address, and Cloudflare Workers hosts the site. Display choices, such as dark mode, stay in this browser.
